text:
Asha Patel: Kicking off the KiteWell pilot scoping thread. Need alignment on the prioritized user journeys, concrete success criteria, required endpoints, and any security/legal blockers. Can folks chime in with short bullets by EOD?

Jon Kim: Happy to. My suggested top 3 journeys (prioritized):
1) Support chat assistant (resolve tier-1 issues, escalate when needed)
2) Document Q&A (indexed product docs + answers)
3) Form autofill / claim-assist (autocomplete & validation hints)

Erin O'Neill: +1 to those. Quick notes on endpoints we should expose for the POC:
- /v1/chat/support -> streaming chat, tool-calls for ticket creation
- /v1/embeddings/search -> semantic doc lookup
- /v1/generate/form-fill -> structured output (JSON schema)

Marco Li: Engineering constraints: prefer single model family for POC to reduce ops overhead. Recommend using quantized 7B variant for cost/latency balance. Plan for autoscaling to handle spikes.

Priya Rao: Security flags from initial review:
- Data residency: KiteWell requires EU residency (eu-west-1) for PII.
- Encryption: TLS + CMK-managed at rest.
- Logs: scrub prompt/response PII before retention; retention window 30d.
- Compliance: need DPA + SOC2 attestation in contract.

Asha Patel: Thanks. Can we make success criteria crisp? Proposed:
- Accuracy/helpfulness: >= 85% on held-out eval (human-rated helpfulness >=4/5)
- Latency: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 800ms for chat path
- Cost: <$200 per 1000 active users per month (ballpark) or < $X per 1M tokens (need finance)
- Business: 30% reduction in human escalations for support journey
- Reliability: 99.9% availability during business hours

Jon Kim: For evals I propose:
- 500 seed prompts for support chat (mix of 60% FAQ, 30% edge troubleshooting, 10% escalation cases)
- 300 doc-QA pairs for embeddings search
- 200 form-fill scenarios (expected json outputs)
- Metrics: exact match for form-fill, retrieval+answer F1 for doc QA, human helpfulness for chat, hallucination rate < 5%

Marco Li: Implementation notes:
- Canary rollout: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error rate >2% or latency p95 increase >40%
- Fallback: if model fails, route to a lightweight retrieval-only answer + human ticket creation

Priya Rao: Security questionnaire items we'll need answers for KiteWell:
- Who has access to raw prompts/responses? (engineering, SRE, customer success?)
- Are prompts persisted? Where and for how long?
- Key management: can customer provide CMK?
- SSO: SAML + SCIM provisioning required
- Pen test & vulnerability scan schedule

Asha Patel: Pricing Qs from customer:
- Is hosted pay-as-you-go available for POC or do they need a reserved Dedicated node?
- Rough estimate for 20M tokens/month vs 100M tokens/month
- Any minimums for enterprise security features (SSO/DPA)?

Erin O'Neill: Quick answers: hosted API ok for POC unless they require VPC/KMS. Dedicated needed for strict data isolation or sustained throughput. I'll loop in finance for token pricing; expect to give a 2-tier quote (hosted vs dedicated).

Jon Kim: Example prompt template for support (to include in eval harness):
```
System: You are a concise technical assistant.
User: My device shows error code 0x42 when syncing. It used to work. What should I do?
Assistant: 
```
Include 3-shot examples and explicit "when unsure, ask for logs" rule.

Priya Rao: On the contract side: legal will require DPA + SOC2, likely CL 9 (data handling) updates. Also confirm we can support EU residency and customer-managed KMS.

DeployBot: New deploy window available next week. Ping @Marco Li to confirm infra changes. :rocket:

Marco Li: I can scope infra changes but need the eval dataset and expected QPS. Estimate: for 100 qps p50 200ms we need 4x small GPU instances for the chosen model.

Asha Patel: Action items / owners / timeline:
- Jon: produce eval seed sets (support 500, doc 300, forms 200) by 1902100000 (next Tue)
- Priya: write security questionnaire answers & confirm KMS options by 1902050000 (Thu)
- Marco: infra scoping + cost estimate for 3 traffic tiers by 1902150000 (Fri next week)
- Erin: confirm hosted vs dedicated pricing band and share with customer by 1902070000

Jon Kim: I'll post the eval CSVs to the shared drive and include expected labels. :thumbsup:

Priya Rao: Will share the minimal security checklist and a list of contract asks.

Asha Patel: Great. Last Q: anyone see critical blockers to starting the POC next week?

Erin O'Neill: Only blocker is SOC2 attestation visibility and SSO onboarding. If customer can accept hosted for 2 weeks and we isolate logs, we can start without Dedicated.

Marco Li: No infra blocker from our side once we have evals and QPS.

Asha Patel: Perfect — thanks all. I'll summarize and send to KiteWell after we get Jon's evals and Priya's security checklist. :eyes:

DeployBot: Thread archived after 14 days of inactivity.
